summary.text: Eric Bell is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 75 who has served since March 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Navy veteran and entrepreneur, he is listed by Ballotpedia as Eric Bell II.

paragraphs.text: Bell graduated from Mundy's Mill High School in 2009 and earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Morehouse College in 2013.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 2013 to 2015.

His career experience includes founding several businesses and working as a government affairs coordinator with Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, a partner with Protees Atl, and deputy chief to then-State Senator Lester Jackson.
Bell succeeded Mike Glanton in District 75, assuming office on March 28, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Defense and Veterans Affairs Committee, the Human Relations and Aging Committee and the Small Business Development Committee.
